title: Hydrogen production and decarbonization with hydrogen absorption-enhanced methanol steam reforming
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,467-480
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01166J, Paper
Xiao Li, Lingzhi Yang, Ke Guo, Bin Wang, Yong Hao
A four-step hydrogen absorption-enhanced methanol steam reforming method is proposed to achieve sustainable hydrogen production, resulting in H2 purity exceeding 99.9% with a recovery rate of 98.92%.
